create_olmoe_config: create an OlmoeConfig instance with default OLMoE 1B-7B hyperparameters for model initialization
initialize_olmoe_model: initialize an OlmoeModel from an OlmoeConfig configuration object for transformer-based language modeling
configure_moe_routing: configure mixture-of-experts routing with num_experts_per_tok, num_experts, and router_aux_loss_coef parameters
set_rope_parameters: set rotary position embedding parameters via rope_parameters for transformer layer positional encoding
get_kv_heads_count: get num_key_value_heads count defaulting to num_attention_heads when not explicitly set
